rec.name: Customer Testimonials Carousel
rec.status: In progress: testimonial content being collected

what.text: A horizontally scrolling carousel of customer review cards. A small eyebrow line sits above a bold heading ("What our customers say"), and prev/next arrow buttons sit at the top right. Each card shows a round avatar, the customer's name, a short bold review title, a 5-star rating and a paragraph of review text. The next card is partly visible at the right edge to signal that the row scrolls.

why.text: Real reviews from people like the visitor reduce perceived risk and build credibility (social proof). The eyebrow line ties the reviews to results ("see how shops perform with us"). Avatars with real names make the quotes feel authentic. Star ratings give a quick visual trust cue. The partly visible next card invites interaction.

how.text: Build a section with an eyebrow text field, a heading field and repeatable review blocks. Each block has an avatar image, name, title, star rating (1-5) and body text. Render the blocks in a horizontal scroll-snap container or slider, three cards per view on desktop, with a partly visible next card. Add prev/next arrow buttons that scroll the container by one card. Use uniform card heights and a subtle card background that contrasts with the section background. Launch with 5-7 real customer reviews.

items: Review blocks (repeatable): avatar image, customer name, review title, star rating, review text
Color scheme (the screenshot shows a dark section with lighter cards and green stars/arrows)

dependencies.text: Needs real customer testimonials. The team plans to contact customers and launch with 5-7 reviews. No app or metafields are mentioned; blocks are presumably stored in the section settings. The ticket doesn't say which page the section goes on, so Home is assumed.

Configurable fields visible in the card layout: avatar, name, title, rating, body text, heading and arrows.
